request.what: Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 for Cardano hardware-wallet support, compatibility assurance, tooling, developer support, release support, and vendor-required audits.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ada, consisting of 1,272,777 ada for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The requested funding covers 12 months of production maintenance for Cardano hardware-wallet support rather than building a new wallet product.

The proposal states that continuous maintenance is needed because Cardano protocol evolution, Ledger and Trezor vendor changes, and wallet and dApp integration demand create compatibility risk for a security-critical access layer.

The proposer claims the work is limited to hardware-wallet compatibility, tooling, vendor-required assurance, and release support, and does not duplicate broader core-node, ledger, or general infrastructure maintenance budgets.

The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting materials, documentation, audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal claims the withdrawal did not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

Intersect will administer the funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts using one Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract, with listed stake and payment addresses.
The proposal states that an Oversight Committee made up of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl will verify key administrative actions using on-chain logic.

The proposal provides high-level authorization thresholds for TRSC funding, disbursement, pause/resume, sweep, and reorganization actions involving Intersect admins, Intersect leadership, and trusted entities.
A dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is presented as available for community audit and tracking of the withdrawn ada, with metrics also described as immutably verifiable on chain.

summary: The document requests 1,310,960 ada for 2026 maintenance of Cardano hardware-wallet compatibility and related tooling, with Intersect administration, smart-contract-based fund controls, third-party oversight, references to budget-process evidence, and on-chain/dashboards for verification.
